subject: [PATCH 2/2] nfsd: fix nfserr type in nfsd_lookup_dentry()

reviews.author: Chuck Lever
reviews.summary: Folded the patch into a previous commit without any further discussion or review.
reviews.raw_body:
On Mon, Aug 3, 2026, at 10:49 AM, Jeff Layton wrote:
> Both nfsd_lookup_dentry() and nfsd_cross_mnt() return __be32.
>
> Fixes: cf78c5a7d742 ("nfsd: move check_nfsd_access() call into 
> nfsd_cross_mnt()")
> Signed-off-by: Jeff Layton <jlayton@kernel.org>
> ---
>  fs/nfsd/vfs.c | 2 +-
>  1 file changed, 1 insertion(+), 1 deletion(-)
>
> diff --git a/fs/nfsd/vfs.c b/fs/nfsd/vfs.c
> index edb08c006a23..807e09521e0c 100644
> --- a/fs/nfsd/vfs.c
> +++ b/fs/nfsd/vfs.c
> @@ -287,7 +287,7 @@ nfsd_lookup_dentry(struct svc_rqst *rqstp, struct 
> svc_fh *fhp,
>  		if (IS_ERR(dentry))
>  			goto out_nfserr;
>  		if (nfsd_mountpoint(dentry, exp)) {
> -			int nfserr = nfsd_cross_mnt(rqstp, &dentry, &exp);
> +			__be32 nfserr = nfsd_cross_mnt(rqstp, &dentry, &exp);
> 
>  			if (nfserr) {
>  				dput(dentry);
>
> -- 
> 2.55.0

Folded into "nfsd: move check_nfsd_access() call into nfsd_cross_mnt()".

-- 
Chuck Lever

2026-08-03.patch_summary: This patch series fixes a type mismatch in the nfsd_lookup_dentry() function, where an __be32 value is being returned as an int. The fix involves changing the return type of nfsd_cross_mnt() to match the expected type.
